relevance_note: The review gives individual-level detail for people with SSADH deficiency (ALDH5A1), for example "A 5-year-old boy presented with severe hyperactivity and a new onset generalized convulsion."
method_note: Review of epilepsy in SSADH deficiency (no stacked ' / ' cells occur in this paper, so the v6 stacked-cell rule was not triggered). In scope: (a) the boy of the 'Patient Vignette', labelled 'patient' by rule 5 (single unnamed patient of the case report; is_proband true), no variant is printed for him (diagnosis by urine organic acids and leucocyte enzyme assay), so he has no variants row; (b) the family of the Neuropathology section - the SUDEP decedent ('unnamed person 1', first mentioned as 'one patient who died with a diagnosis of SUDEP'), her living sister ('sister of unnamed person 1') and both parents ('parent of unnamed person 1', 'parent of unnamed person 1 2', sex not stated); the parents are described only as 'heterozygote carriers', so their variants rows carry variant_original_string 'not reported' with zygosity heterozygous; (c) people from earlier reports summarised in the text: a parent and a sibling of one family with heterozygosity ([7] -> 'ref [7] patient', 'ref [7] patient 2'), two adolescent brothers with exercise-induced paroxysmal dyskinesias ([27] -> 'ref [27] patient', 'ref [27] patient 2') and a 2 1/2-year-old boy treated with taurine ([33] -> 'ref [33] patient'); their per-person reference is in source_reference_in_review. Out of scope and only counted: the clinical database patients (Tables 1-4 are counts without names, so they give no individuals and no features), the 33 patients over ten years of age, the ten patients with polysomnography, the eight sets of patients and heterozygous parents studied by TMS, and the unaffected parent heterozygotes studied by FMZ-PET. publications.n_patients_reported and cohort_size_as_stated both take the stated database figure of 68; the paper also says SSADH deficiency 'has been reported in approximately 450 people', which is a literature-wide figure, not this study's cohort. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is true because the paper states that the authors reported on 33 of these patients earlier [3] (and sleep study data in ten patients [8]); prior_report_citation gives [3]. Uncertainties recorded rather than resolved: the sister's 'borderline cognition (IQ = 70)' was not mapped to the checklist item 'intellectual disability' and the checklist item is 'not reported' for her; the reference title of [27] says 'paroxysmal dystonia' while the paper's own sentence says 'paroxysmal dyskinesias', so dystonia is 'not reported' for those two brothers and only 'exertional dyskinesia' is marked observed; the two brothers and the boy of [33] have no checklist feature reported (only treatment responses); for the decedent, the neuropathology paragraph is cited to [15] but the paper presents the case as its own, so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported'; the decedent's globus pallidus discoloration is an autopsy finding, not MRI, so the T2-hyperintensity checklist item is 'not reported' for her. No internal contradictions were found. Every span was copied by hand from the Markdown; no script transcribed any table.

span: Title: Epilepsy in Succinic Semialdehyde Dehydrogenase Deficiency, a Disorder of GABA Metabolism

This paper addresses the seizure and EEG data associated with human SSADH deficiency and ongoing research in the human condition and murine model aimed at elucidating the mechanisms underlying epilepsy in this metabolic disorder.
